en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard. The picture side shows a broad view of a hilly landscape with vineyards and terraces, with prominent stone ruins in the foreground and scattered buildings at the edges. At the top it is captioned in Hungarian "Pécs–Tettye" and "A fennsík teljes látképe". The reverse side has a green Hungarian stamp, dense handwritten text in Hungarian, and printed heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" with the address written to Budapest.
